facts.fact: US programmatic digital display ad spending is expected to grow three times as fast as non-programmatic digital display ad spending in 2024, per eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: US programmatic digital display ad spending is expected to grow three times that of non-programmatic digital display ad spending in 2024

facts.fact: Demand-side platforms use real-time bidding, which uses machine learning to automatically bid on ad impressions that match an advertiser's targeting criteria.
facts.quote: This is done through real-time bidding (RTB), which uses machine learning to automatically bid on ad impressions that match an advertiser’s precise targeting criteria.

facts.fact: Supply-side platforms are used by publishers and digital media owners to manage, sell, and optimize their ad inventory by automatically selling ad space to the highest bidders in real-time auctions.
facts.quote: automatically selling ad space to the highest bidders in real-time auctions

facts.fact: Ad exchanges are centralized platforms that connect advertisers with publishers; advertisers access them via DSPs and publishers make inventory available through SSPs.
facts.quote: Advertisers access these exchanges via DSPs, whereas publishers make their inventory available through SSPs.

facts.fact: According to a eMarketer forecast cited by StackAdapt, US display ad spend will total $261.76 billion by 2028 through programmatic channels.
facts.quote: display ad spend will total [$261.76 billion](https://www.emarketer.com/insights/programmatic-digital-display-ad-spending/) in the US alone by 2028

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article identifies four adtech trends to watch: 1st-party data and cookieless alternatives, AI in adtech, CTV overtaking linear TV, and white-label solutions and consolidation.
facts.quote: These four trends will undoubtedly shape adtech for the foreseeable future.

facts.fact: In the ad delivery step, the ad exchange selects the highest bidder from the participating DSPs, and the winning advertiser's ad is displayed to the user.
facts.quote: The ad exchange selects the highest bidder from the participating DSPs, and the winning advertiser's ad is displayed to the user
